skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts related to information resources management in economic and social organizations, especially in businesses.
Explain the basics related to IT investment and its effectiveness in businesses.
Deploy strategic IT planning methods for organizations.
Use management information systems to enhance business efficiency and competitive advantage.
Implement basic IT investment contents, assess and review IT investment projects, legal procedures for calculating costs and benefits of IT investments.
Develop skills in analyzing and planning IT systems within organizations and determining and organizing effective IT investment projects.
Possess self-study skills for IT resources within organizations.
Possess independent work skills or actively, positively, and effectively participate in group activities.
Possess the ability to organize group activities.
Possess social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of management information systems.
